hero.title: Hologram with QR Code
hero.subtitle: Premium authentication solution with 2 layers of protection
hero.description: A combination of multi-layer hologram with an integrated QR code to create a dual security layer that is almost impossible to counterfeit. Ideal solution for premium, high-value products, and industries requiring maximum protection.

overview.title: About This Service
description: Hologram with QR is our flagship authentication solution that combines the strength of physical security (premium hologram) with digital security (AG QR code). Each label is produced with multi-layer hologram technology that has a unique, hard-to-imitate visual effect, equipped with a QR code connected directly to the Authentic Guards real-time database.

This solution is designed specifically for brands requiring maximum protection for premium products, high-value goods, or products vulnerable to sophisticated counterfeiting. With 2 layers of protection working synergistically, counterfeiters must defeat both layers at once to create a convincing fake product, an almost impossible challenge.
highlights: Multi-layer hologram with premium visual effects
QR code integrated with real-time database
Custom design according to brand identity

features.title: Premium Multi-Layer Hologram
features.description: Hologram technology with an almost impossible-to-imitate multi-layer visual effect. Each hologram has a unique pattern that can be visually verified by consumers and retailers.

features.title: Integrated AG QR Code
features.description: QR code developed based on the international ISO/IEC 18084:2015 specification, connected directly to the Authentic Guards cloud database. Each code is unique per product, interoperable with all standard QR readers, and cannot be duplicated.

features.title: Tamper-Evident Design
features.description: Labels are designed with tamper-evident features that show signs of opening. When the label is opened/removed, the QR code automatically becomes invalid and is considered void.

features.title: Real-time Verification
features.description: Every scan is directly validated against the AG cloud database to ISO/IEC 27000:2016 standards. The system logs every verification activity for analytics and anomaly detection.

implementation.title: Implementation Flow
implementation.description: A structured implementation process to ensure the quality and success of every project.

steps.title: Consultation & Analysis
steps.description: In-depth discussion to understand the brand's specific needs, product type, production volume, and required security level.

steps.title: Design & Prototyping
steps.description: Our design team creates hologram mockups according to brand identity. A prototype is produced for approval before mass production.

steps.title: AG Code Production
steps.description: The system generates unique AG codes with a 3-layer algorithm, MD5-hashed, and stored in an ISO/IEC 27000:2016-compliant cloud database.

steps.title: Hologram Label Production
steps.description: Hologram labels are produced with multi-layer technology, equipped with QR codes and tamper-evident features per specification.

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.description: Quality checking of labels for defects and errors. Labels that fail QC are destroyed with standard procedures.

steps.title: Delivery & Implementation
steps.description: Labels are shipped to clients with complete documentation. Our team assists with label application on products and system usage training.

items.q: What is the minimum order for hologram labels?
items.a: Minimum order quantity (MOQ) varies depending on design complexity and label size. For detailed information and the best quote, please contact our sales team for a direct consultation.

items.q: How long is the hologram label production time?
items.a: Standard production time is ±14 business days after design approval, in accordance with our service terms. For special needs, the timeline can be discussed further with our team.

items.q: Can the hologram design be fully custom?
items.a: Absolutely! Our design team will work with you to create a custom hologram according to your brand identity. From pattern, color, visual effects, to label size and shape.

items.q: What if there are production-defective labels?
items.a: We will compensate with new labels for defects up to 2.5% of total production. Defective code reports are submitted monthly by the client with a notification letter and evidence, then the QC team stamps the custom tape with a rejection note.

items.q: Are these labels resistant to weather and scratches?
items.a: Yes, our hologram labels come with anti-UV, anti-scratch, and waterproof coating. Labels are designed to withstand normal product use conditions.

items.q: What is the consumer verification process?
items.a: Consumers simply scan the QR code on the label using a smartphone. The system verifies product authenticity in real-time and displays the authenticity status within seconds. Each code has a 15-time verification limit to prevent duplication.

items.q: Are there solutions other than hologram?
items.a: Yes, we also provide Tafeta Labels with QR for the fashion industry. For other technology solutions such as NFC, currently still in the research and development stage. Please contact our team for more information.
